description: This file contains utility functions and constants for pandas post-processing within the Superset project, including numpy function mappings, aggregation helpers, and string escaping utilities.

methods.name: _is_multi_index_on_columns
methods.description: Checks if a DataFrame has a MultiIndex on its columns.

methods.name: scalar_to_sequence
methods.description: Converts a value to a sequence of strings.

methods.name: validate_column_args
methods.description: Decorator to validate column arguments in functions.

methods.name: _get_aggregate_funcs
methods.description: Converts aggregate configurations into pandas-compatible aggregation functions.

methods.name: _append_columns
methods.description: Adds or replaces columns in a DataFrame based on another DataFrame and a column mapping.

methods.name: escape_separator
methods.description: Escapes separator characters in a string.

methods.name: unescape_separator
methods.description: Unescapes separator characters in a string.
